name: Duplicate It – Duplicate Post, Page & Custom Post Types (Fast & Lightweight)
author: Smartz Minds

sections.description:
Duplicate It is a powerful and lightweight WordPress duplicate post plugin designed to help you quickly duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types without any hassle.

Whether you need to duplicate a post in WordPress, clone a page, or bulk duplicate content, this plugin makes the process smooth, fast, and reliable.

It works seamlessly with modern editors like Elementor and Gutenberg, ensuring your layouts and designs remain intact after duplication.

Save time, reuse designs, and scale content faster — no need to rebuild pages from scratch.

🚀 Key Features

✅ One-click duplicate posts & pages instantly
✅ Bulk duplicate WordPress content in seconds
✅ Duplicate custom post types (CPT) easily
✅ Fully compatible with Elementor & Gutenberg
✅ Set duplicate status (draft, publish, private or pending)
✅ Auto rename titles with prefix/suffix (e.g., Copy, Draft)
✅ Create multiple copies in one click
✅ Stay or redirect after duplication
✅ Quick duplicate option in post/page list
✅ Role-based access control

⚡ Why Choose Duplicate It?

Unlike heavy duplicate plugins, Duplicate It focuses on performance, simplicity, and speed.

🚫 No ads, no clutter
⚡ Optimized for speed — faster than most duplicate plugins
🎯 Works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, and WPBakery builders
⚡ Lightweight & high performance
🎯 Clean and user-friendly interface

Perfect for developers, bloggers, agencies, and content creators.

💡 Use Cases

🔹 Clone Elementor landing pages instantly
🔹 Duplicate blog posts for updates or A/B testing
🔹 Create reusable templates quickly
🔹 Bulk duplicate pages for large websites
🔹 Duplicate WooCommerce or custom post type content

📌 How to Duplicate a Post or Page in WordPress

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Posts or Pages
  3. Click the “Duplicate” link below any item
  4. Your duplicate will be created instantly
  5. Use Bulk Actions → Duplicate for multiple items

🎥 Video Tutorial

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best duplicate post plugin for WordPress?

Duplicate It is a fast and lightweight plugin that lets you duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types instantly.

How do I duplicate a post in WordPress?

Install the plugin, go to Posts, and click the Duplicate link under any post.

How do I duplicate a page in WordPress?

Go to Pages and click the Duplicate option below the page title.

Can I bulk duplicate posts in WordPress?

Yes, select multiple posts and use Bulk Actions → Duplicate.

Does this plugin support Elementor and Gutenberg?

Yes, it works perfectly with both editors.

Can I duplicate custom post types?

Yes, all custom post types (CPT) are supported.

Can I set duplicate post status?

Yes, choose draft, published, private, or pending.

Is Duplicate It free?

Yes, it is completely free and lightweight.

  • WordPress 3.4+
  • PHP 5.x
  • MySQL 5.x

📞 Support
